# chainlaunch_external_nodes (Data Source)

Retrieve all external nodes (Fabric peers, orderers, and Besu nodes) that have been synced from remote Chainlaunch instances.

This data source provides a comprehensive view of all external nodes in a single API call, including:
- Fabric peers with certificates and endpoints
- Fabric orderers with certificates and endpoints
- Besu nodes with enode URLs and P2P configuration

Use this data source after running `chainlaunch_sync_all_external_nodes` or `chainlaunch_external_nodes_sync` to retrieve the complete list of synced nodes.

**Benefits over individual data sources**:
- Single API call for all node types
- More efficient than querying each type separately
- Comprehensive view of the entire external node landscape



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `besu_nodes` (Attributes List) List of external Hyperledger Besu nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--besu_nodes))
- `fabric_orderers` (Attributes List) List of external Fabric orderer nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabric_orderers))
- `fabric_peers` (Attributes List) List of external Fabric peer nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabric_peers))

<a id="nestedatt--besu_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `besu_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `enode_url` (String) Enode URL for peer-to-peer connections (e.g., 'enode://publickey@host:port')
- `external_node_id` (Number) ID of the external node this Besu node belongs to
- `id` (Number) External Besu node ID
- `metrics_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Prometheus metrics are enabled
- `metrics_port` (Number) Metrics endpoint port (if metrics enabled)
- `name` (String) Besu node name
- `p2p_host` (String) P2P host address
- `p2p_port` (Number) P2P port number
- `version` (String) Hyperledger Besu version


<a id="nestedatt--fabric_orderers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fabric_orderers`

Read-Only:

- `external_endpoint` (String) External endpoint address (e.g., 'orderer0.org1.example.com:7050')
- `external_node_id` (Number) ID of the external node this orderer belongs to
- `id` (Number) External orderer ID
- `msp_id` (String) MSP ID of the orderer's organization
- `name` (String) Orderer name
- `sign_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded signing certificate
- `tls_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded TLS certificate
- `version` (String) Hyperledger Fabric version


<a id="nestedatt--fabric_peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fabric_peers`

Read-Only:

- `external_endpoint` (String) External endpoint address (e.g., 'peer0.org1.example.com:7051')
- `external_node_id` (Number) ID of the external node this peer belongs to
- `id` (Number) External peer ID
- `msp_id` (String) MSP ID of the peer's organization
- `name` (String) Peer name
- `sign_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded signing certificate
- `tls_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded TLS certificate
- `version` (String) Hyperledger Fabric version
